glyph_origin: Original form was 恖, considered by Shuowen to be a phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 囟 + semantic 心 (“heart”). It may also be a ideogrammic compound (會意): 囟 (“fontanel”) + 心 (“heart”). 囟 started to corrupt into the unrelated 田 as early as the silk script.
shuowen: Original form was 恖, considered by Shuowen to be a phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 囟 + semantic 心 (“heart”).
senses: [sī] (literary, or in compounds) to think; to cogitate
[sāi] (obsolete in standard Chinese) alternative form of 䰄 (“heavily bearded”)
